analysis.summary: Users can sort inventory products by name (A‑Z, Z‑A) or price (low‑high, high‑low) and the list must reorder immediately after selection.

explicit_requirements.statement: Users must be able to sort the products on the inventory page by name and by price.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Users must be able to sort the products on the inventory page by name and by price.

explicit_requirements.statement: The list must reorder immediately after a sort option is selected.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: The list must reorder immediately after a sort option is selected.

explicit_requirements.statement: Sorting by name A to Z lists products in ascending alphabetical order.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Sorting by name A to Z lists products in ascending alphabetical order.

explicit_requirements.statement: Sorting by name Z to A lists products in descending alphabetical order.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Sorting by name Z to A lists products in descending alphabetical order.

explicit_requirements.statement: Sorting by price low to high lists the cheapest product first.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Sorting by price low to high lists the cheapest product first.

explicit_requirements.statement: Sorting by price high to low lists the most expensive product first.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Sorting by price high to low lists the most expensive product first.

scenarios.title: Sort by name A‑Z and verify ascending alphabetical order
Sort by name Z‑A and verify descending alphabetical order
Sort by price low‑high and verify cheapest product appears first
Sort by price high‑low and verify most expensive product appears first
Select any sort option and verify the list reorders immediately

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Sort when product list is empty
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Behavior for an empty inventory is not defined in the requirements.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Sort with duplicate product names or prices
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Handling of ties (e.g., same name or price) is not specified.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Performance of sorting large product catalogs
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: No performance or latency expectations are provided.

missing_information: Exact UI control used to select sort option
Case sensitivity rules for alphabetical sorting
How ties are resolved when names or prices are identical
Impact of pagination or lazy loading on sorting
assumptions: The inventory page displays a single, flat list of products without pagination for the purpose of sorting
analysis.validation_notes: All explicit statements from the user have been captured as functional requirements and corresponding derived test scenarios. No contradictions were found.
